create_logger_instance: create a Logger instance with quiet mode to write log lines to a file instead of stdout
add_line_to_logger: add a line of content to the Logger which writes to file or prints depending on quiet mode
create_progress_meter: create a ProgressMeter to track training batches with meters for a given phase and epoch
display_progress_meter: display the current batch progress with meter values to stdout or a Logger instance
synchronize_meters_across_gpus: synchronize meter averages across all GPUs using torch distributed all_gather in a multi-GPU setup
